description: BitcoinYield is a live crypto-yield comparison site that ranks earning opportunities for Bitcoin, stablecoins, ETH, SOL, and other assets across DeFi and CeFi by yield and risk. It publishes current yield snapshots, offer comparisons, and methodology pages for tracked assets and platforms.
summary: Public integration surface includes one unauthenticated REST API with an OpenAPI spec and one unauthenticated Streamable HTTP MCP server.
